description: Hand-written AnswerContract responses for the offline eval run. Not provider output. Change only when cases or the contract change.

normal-parental-leave-pay.answer_text: Parental Leave is 16 weeks, paid at 100% by GitLab minus any State Disability or PFL benefits offset.

normal-fmla-eligibility.answer_text: Up to 12 weeks of job-protected leave; eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service and 1250 hours worked in the prior year.

normal-how-to-request.answer_text: US leave requests go through Tilt, accessed via Okta; Tilt can also be contacted by email or text.

normal-cfra-pay.answer_text: CFRA leave is generally unpaid, but state disability or PFL benefits, PTO or sick leave may apply; the pay table shows the split by week.

missing-data-military-leave.answer_text: USERRA covers active and reserve duty leave up to a cumulative 5 years, and the first 25 days are paid at 100%. The final answer depends on your duty type.
missing-data-military-leave.clarifying_question: What branch and type of duty is this, and how many days do you need?

unsupported-eligibility-fmla-4-months.answer_text: FMLA requires 12 months of continuous service and 1250 hours worked in the prior year; 4 months does not meet this requirement. Please contact HR.

out-of-scope-texas-detail.answer_text: The documents only list which leave types exist in Texas, such as Emergency Evacuation Leave and Voting Leave; they do not give detailed rules for them.
